mapper.sql: m.application_id application,m.version,m.content_hash,COALESCE(r.presentation_hash,d.presentation_hash) presentation_hash,m.published_by, to_char(m.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') published_at, r.command_id,r.command_hash,r.source_commit,r.artifact_hash,r.reason,r.decision,r.base_version,r.base_content_hash,r.base_presentation_hash,r.preview_json

FROM auth_governance.application_manifest m LEFT JOIN auth_governance.catalog_release r ON r.application_id=m.application_id AND r.version=m.version LEFT JOIN auth_governance.application_manifest_presentation d ON d.application_id=m.application_id AND d.version=m.version
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE m.application_id=#{app} AND m.version <#{before} ORDER BY m.version DESC LIMIT #{limit}
